Design the experiment yourself: choose the parameters, training or search budget, number of repetitions and seeds, the metrics you will report and the success criterion, and declare the metrics and the experiment entrypoint in the plan before running anything. Implement the solution as small, single-purpose modules with unit tests, produce every result by running the declared entrypoint, and write the thesis so that every reported number is a symbolic pointer to the code or to a results file.
